title: What Staking Is
summary: Staking means locking up coins to help secure a Proof-of-Stake network, and in return earning rewards paid by the protocol.
blocks: Staking means locking up coins to help secure a Proof-of-Stake network, and in return earning rewards paid by the protocol.
By committing a stake, participants earn the right to help validate transactions; acting dishonestly can cost them part of that stake.
Rewards are not free money — they come with lock-up periods, potential penalties, and the ordinary price risk of holding the coin. The details vary by network.
